title: International RSE Survey 2022 — Germany
text:
Survey overview
This book presents the 2022 survey independently for Germany, using the questions and answer options stored in that year’s export.
Country scope: Germany
Source records: 1003
Records matching country scope: 258
Respondents included: 258
Question groups discovered: 80
Submitted and partial records are included. Each question uses only records with a recorded answer to that question.
Only respondents whose socio1_0 value is Germany are included.
No cross-year harmonisation is applied.
Submitted records: 210
Partial records: 48
